patch_description: The best-performing prior variant (score 0.87) used: RY layer -> alternating-shared CRZ ring -> per-qubit RX layer -> single-shared-param CRZ skip layer, with ~116 params. The current program (a different, RZ/CZ-heavy variant) underperforms (0.83) with far more params (194) and a larger loss/gap. This edit reverts the EVOLVE-BLOCK to the stronger RY/CRZ-ring/RX/CRZ-skip structure and, per the recommendation, inserts a lightweight mid-circuit RZ rotation layer (one param per qubit, "rz_mid_i") between the RX layer and the skip-entanglement block. This adds a non-commuting rotation axis right before the long-range entangling layer, which should enrich the reachable state manifold and help convergence, while only adding 8 params per repetition (a modest increase, consistent with the ~+8 depth guidance) rather than the large parameter blow-up seen in the current underperforming variant.
